Revoke a personal access token, or a deploy token with --repo

Revoke a token at once; it cannot be undone and every client that uses it
stops working. Without --repo the id is one of YOUR personal access tokens (see
rp token list); with --repo &lt;name&gt; it is a deploy token of that repository.

rp asks for confirmation on a terminal. In a script pass --yes; with --no-input
or without a terminal, and no --yes, the command exits 2 and revokes nothing.

Revoking the personal access token that rp itself signs with makes the next
rp command fail with exit 4; log in again with rp auth.

```
rp token revoke <token-id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --repo string   Revoke a deploy token of this repository (without it: a personal access token)
```
